additional_info.subject: RE: ID0434047-DC/Si-D/FR - [MP / P5 170000506] When EVSE 1 is charging, EVSE 3 is unavailable CRM:02919000044
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0434047 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
The customer has reported an issue wherein EVSE 3 becomes unavailable when EVSE 1 is actively charging. Upon investigation, we observed a Switching Matrix fault related to QA9-10, specifically a coil stuck at OFF feedback condition.
Kindly plan a site visit to address this issue. During the visit, please proceed with the replacement of the QA9-10 contactor and subsequently attempt to charge the vehicle via DC1 and then DC3, if feasible, to verify system functionality.
Component details for ordering:
MLFB: 8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8
Description: Contactor DC 2P 500A 1200VDC

Applicable

eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.

unified service process
.
